name: Tavern Brawler
summary: Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 + Strength and reroll 1s, push foes 5 feet; proficiency with improvised weapons.

benefits.name: Enhanced Unarmed Strike
benefits.summary: Your Unarmed Strike can deal 1d4 + Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage.
benefits.text: When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 plus your Strength modifier instead of the strike's normal damage.

benefits.name: Damage Rerolls
benefits.summary: Reroll any 1 on an Unarmed Strike damage die.
benefits.text: Whenever you roll a damage die for your Unarmed Strike and it shows a 1, you can reroll it, and you must use the new result.

benefits.name: Improvised Weaponry
benefits.summary: You are proficient with improvised weapons.
benefits.text: You have proficiency with improvised weapons.

benefits.name: Push
benefits.summary: Once per turn, an Unarmed Strike hit during the Attack action can both damage and push the target 5 feet.
benefits.text: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can deal damage to it and also push it 5 feet away from you. You can use this benefit only once per turn.
